    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    ChatThread
    Runnable that simulates an asynchronous chat exchange between students.
    DataParser
    Utility class responsible for translating raw input files into UniversityStudent objects that the rest of the system can use.
    FriendRequestThread
    Runnable that models processing of a friend request event between two students.
    GaleShapley
    Implements the Gale-Shapley stable matching algorithm to pair students with compatible roommates based on their ranked preferences.
    LonghornNetworkUI
    Simple Swing UI that visualizes the core Longhorn Network components.
    Main
    Entry point for the Longhorn Network autograder harness that bundles predefined scenarios and exercises every component.
    PodFormation
    Coordinates the grouping of students into pods based on connection strength or other criteria derived from the StudentGraph.
    ReferralPathFinder
    Provides referral-path discovery logic using graph traversal algorithms such as Dijkstra's to find routes to a desired internship company.
    Student
    Base abstraction for every Longhorn Network participant.
    StudentGraph
    Weighted, undirected graph that models connection strengths between students.
    StudentGraph.Edge
    Graph edge representation.
    UniversityStudent
    Concrete representation of a student at the university that will participate in roommate matching, pod formation, and referral searches.
